tables.name: now_reference_errors
tables.notes: Skill = 1 - mean/1.53. Same figures are sourced in research/data/single-image-regression.json; here they are carried as expert knowledge. Best-entry median is the midpoint of a recalled 0.75-0.8 range. Differences < 0.1 mm are within protocol noise.

tables.name: realy_region_error_ranges
tables.units: mm (REALY frontal track, per-region mean nearest-point error after region-wise alignment)
rows: largest spread across methods; expression leakage
HRN-class methods ≈1.5-1.6 at the low end
tables.population: REALY subjects (≈100 Headspace scans); methods Deep3D, DECA, 3DDFA_V2, HRN, 3DDFA-V3 (2022-24)
tables.notes: Ranges recalled, not per-method values; verify before use.

tables.name: nearest_vertex_bias
tables.units: mm; mean lateral offset to nearest vertex on a triangular lattice = 0.351 x edge length (Monte Carlo)
tables.population: geometric arithmetic (uniform points over an equilateral triangular lattice)
tables.notes: Adds in quadrature to the true perpendicular error when distance is measured to the nearest vertex instead of the nearest surface point. Use point-to-triangle distances.

tables.name: error_floors
rows: stereophotogrammetry scanner accuracy, rigid target (vendor claims)
tables.notes: Use 0.3-0.5 mm as heatmap deadband; measure your own scanner by scanning twice.

tables.name: acceptance_targets
tables.units: mm RMS / mm p95 after alignment; scale in %
tables.population: adult face crop with a reference scan; design defaults, not measured norms
tables.notes: Global NoW-style targets: median <= 0.8 mm, mean <= 1.0 mm. Metric scale error <= 1.5 % with a reference. Weights from research/anatomy/face-perception-likeness.md Table B.
